Incident Description: Multiple unsuccessful login attempts against a privileged account
Corrective Action: Review authentication logs and verify account security

Incident Description: Suspicious email containing a potentially malicious attachment reported by an employee
Corrective Action: Analyse email headers and attachment safely and determine whether execution occurred

Incident Description: Alert indicating a potentially unauthorised cloud security configuration change
Corrective Action: Review cloud audit logs and verify whether the change was authorised

Incident Description: Customer reports unexpected access activity involving a financial record
Corrective Action: Review database access logs and validate the reported activity

Incident Description: Security monitoring identifies a period of missing log ingestion
Corrective Action: Investigate log collection pipeline and assess monitoring coverage
